note: Made by the steps in TV_PICTURES.md: the chapter is split into sections that each carry one deep meaning ("sections"), 10 picture ideas are written for each, the top two for each picture are made and the better is chosen by eye (2026-11-22). Wide pictures only (1920x1088); the "tall" names are kept for the day tall pictures are switched back on. Each scene starts at the first word of its verse. The important part of every picture sits in the upper two thirds, clear of the words. God and the cherubim are not pictured, and the man and the woman of the chapter are not portrayed as biblical people: their story is shown through the text's own images (the snake, the fruit, the fig leaves, the guarded gate) and through ordinary people of today. Nothing violent and no nakedness is shown. 27 of 28 trial pictures were made (the fig-leaf sewing trial failed twice and was not needed: the other fig-leaf picture shows the meaning).
method: Second method, asked for by Obay on 2026-11-21: (1) split the chapter into sections that each carry one deep meaning, written as one plain sentence; (2) write 10 different picture ideas for each section; (3) judge them: which shows the deep meaning most truly, then which a watcher understands at once while hearing the words, then which is most engaging; (4) make the top two for each picture slot as real pictures ("candidates") and choose by eye. A section has one or two pictures.

sections.meaning: A cunning voice twists what God said and promises that breaking his one command will bring no death, only eyes opened and being like God.
ideas: A sleek snake coils along a low branch of a single fruit tree in the middle of a sunny present-day garden, its head raised beside the ripe fruit
Close-up of a snake's gleaming eye and flicking tongue among the leaves of a fruit tree, a ripe fruit hanging beside its head
Underwater, a bright shiny fishing lure glints in a shaft of light, its hook hidden, as a fish swims toward it
A small mouse creeps toward a tempting piece of cheese on a set mousetrap
A smooth salesman leans close and whispers to a young woman, who listens with a doubtful frown
A teenager at a fence with a padlocked gate while a friend beside him smirks and waves him through
A glossy red fruit on a branch, perfect on the side facing us, rotten on the side turned away
A crooked signpost turned round so that it points the wrong way down a road
A man looks into a fairground mirror that shows him tall and grand
A single fruit tree fenced off in the middle of a bright orchard, every other tree open to the picker

sections.meaning: The fruit looked good and desirable, so they took it and ate, and the moment their eyes opened they saw only their own shame and tried to cover it.
ideas: Close-up of a woman's hand passing a ripe red fruit with one bite out of it into a man's open hand, the fruit tree's leaves behind
A woman's hand reaches up for a single perfect glossy fruit hanging in bright light, her fingers about to close round it
Two pairs of hands hurriedly stitching big green fig leaves together with needle and thread
Under a fig tree a young man and woman sit apart, each hiding their face in their hands, a pile of picked fig leaves between them
A young woman blushes and pulls a blanket round her shoulders as if suddenly caught
A bitten fruit lies browning on the grass under the tree
A man catches sight of himself in a mirror and turns his face away
A pair of hands holds a garment made of sewn-together fig leaves up to the light
A spotlight suddenly snaps on over a couple standing in the dark, who throw up their arms
A woman's eyes widen in shock as she looks down at herself

sections.meaning: Guilt makes them hide from God when he comes looking and calls 'Where are you?', and when asked, each one passes the blame to someone else.
ideas: In a sunny living room a small boy hides behind a long curtain beside a broken vase, as his father's shadow falls across the floor from the doorway
At dusk in a big garden a man crouches behind a tree trunk, hiding, looking back toward the warm light of an opened house door
Beside a broken vase a boy points at his little sister, and the sister points at the family dog
In a kitchen beside a smashed plate a husband points at his wife, and she points at the cat on the counter
A child hides under a table with crumbs round his mouth beside an empty cookie jar
A father seen from behind stands in an evening garden, calling out with his hand cupped to his mouth
A teenager sits in a dark closet with the door shut, holding his breath
A row of three people, each pointing a finger at the next
A man lowers a wide-brimmed hat over his face as footsteps come near
Muddy footprints lead across a clean floor straight to a closed door with someone hiding behind it

sections.meaning: The deceiver is brought down into the dust, and a lasting war is set between it and the woman's offspring, who will strike its head while it strikes his heel.
ideas: A snake slides on its belly across dry, dusty, cracked ground, its head low in the dirt
At ground level, a dust-covered snake crawls flat along a dry path under a wide sky
On a dusty trail a hiker's heavy boot comes down over the head of a rearing snake that strikes at the heel
Ground-level close-up: a snake's open mouth just short of a boot heel as the boot's sole comes down over its head
A snake and a mongoose face each other on dry ground
A snake trapped low in a deep dusty ditch
A gardener stands squarely before a reared snake on a garden path
A boot planted firmly on a dusty path where a snake lies still
A snake's shed skin lying in the dust
A heel with a small wound beside a snake slipping away into the grass

sections.meaning: New life will now come through great pain, and the bond between the woman and her husband will be marked by longing and by his rule over her.
ideas: In a hospital room a woman in labour grips her husband's hand with all her strength, her face strained with pain
Close-up of a woman's hand in labour gripping a man's hand so hard her knuckles are white
A heavily pregnant woman holds her aching back as she climbs a flight of stairs
A newborn's first cry in the arms of a worn-out mother
A woman looks longingly after her husband as he walks away without turning round
A mother awake at night with a crying baby while the house sleeps
A woman's hands on her large belly as she winces
A wife reaches for her husband's hand while he looks the other way
A delivery-room bed rail gripped by one tight hand
A tired mother on a kitchen floor surrounded by small children

sections.meaning: Because of the man the ground is cursed: work becomes sweat and struggle against thorns, until he returns to the dust he was taken from.
ideas: Under a hot white sky a farmer in a sweat-soaked shirt hacks at thorns and thistles in a dry stony field, sweat running down his face
Close-up of a man's scratched, dirty hands in worn gloves pulling a big thorny thistle from cracked dry earth
An old man's weathered open hand lets dry earth run out between his fingers, falling back to the ground
An old farmer sits resting at the edge of his field at the end of the day, a handful of dry soil in his palm
A labourer wipes the sweat from his face with his forearm beside a plain loaf of bread
A plough stuck fast in hard cracked ground
A vegetable plot choked with thistles despite the gardener's efforts
A worn tool handle polished smooth by years of hard work
An empty pair of old work boots standing on dry ground
Dust blowing off a dry field into the wind

sections.meaning: Even after their failure, life goes on through the woman, mother of all the living, and God himself clothes them with care.
ideas: At the door of a warm house on a cold windy evening, an older man seen from behind wraps a thick sheepskin coat round a shivering young couple
An older man seen from behind gently lays a warm sheepskin coat round the shoulders of a young mother holding her newborn
A father's hands buttoning a warm coat on his grown son
A young mother lifts her newborn into the morning light
A great-grandmother holds a baby surrounded by four generations of her family
A thick warm sheepskin coat hung ready on a hook beside an open door in the cold
A mother tucks a warm blanket round her sleeping children
A father drapes his own jacket over his daughter's shoulders in the rain
Hands stitching a warm leather garment by lamplight
A young couple in new warm coats step out into the cold together

sections.meaning: They are sent out of the garden into the hard world to work the ground, and the way back to the tree of life is shut and guarded by fire.
ideas: Seen from behind, a young couple with small bundles walk away along a dusty road from the open gate of a lush walled garden
A man seen from behind walks out of a lush green garden into a bare dry field with a shovel on his shoulder
A tall closed iron gate in a high garden wall with a wall of flame across the path before it, a single great tree shining inside
A blazing wheel of turning fire hangs before an arched gateway into a lush garden, a radiant tree far inside
A couple look back through the bars of a locked garden gate at the green paradise inside
A gate swinging shut on a lush garden, seen from the dusty road
A single radiant tree on a far green hill beyond a deep gorge
Footprints in the dust leading away from a green garden gate
A key turning in the lock of an old garden door
A ring of fire round a lone tree on a hilltop at night

scenes.principle: The snake, shrewder than any wild animal, twists God's word: did God really say you must not eat from any tree?
scenes.shows: Close-up of a snake's gleaming eye and flicking tongue among the leaves of a fruit tree, a ripe fruit beside its head.
scenes.prompt: Close-up among the green leaves of a fruit tree: a snake's head, its gleaming watchful eye and its forked tongue flicking out, rests right beside a ripe glossy red fruit hanging from the branch. Soft bright daylight through the leaves. The important part is in the upper two thirds of the picture.

scenes.principle: The lie: you will certainly not die; your eyes will be opened and you will be like God.
scenes.shows: A small mouse creeps toward a tempting piece of cheese on a set mousetrap.
scenes.prompt: On a worn wooden kitchen floor a set wooden mousetrap holds a tempting golden piece of cheese. A small brown mouse creeps up to it, whiskers twitching, nose almost touching the cheese. The trap and the mouse are in the upper part of the frame, in warm lamplight. The important part is in the upper two thirds of the picture.

scenes.principle: She saw the fruit was good and desirable, took it and ate, and gave some to her husband, and he ate.
scenes.shows: A woman's hand passes a ripe red fruit with one bite out of it into a man's open hand.
scenes.prompt: Close-up in a sunny orchard: a woman's hand passes a ripe red fruit with one fresh bite taken out of it into a man's open waiting hand. Only their hands and forearms in plain everyday sleeves are seen, with the fruit tree's green leaves softly behind. The important part is in the upper two thirds of the picture.

scenes.principle: Their eyes were opened, they knew they were naked, and they covered themselves with sewn fig leaves.
scenes.shows: Under a fig tree a young man and woman sit apart, each hiding their face in their hands, picked fig leaves between them.
scenes.prompt: Under a leafy fig tree a young man and a young woman of today, fully dressed in plain clothes, sit apart on the grass, turned away from each other, each hiding their face in their hands in shame. A pile of large picked fig leaves lies on the grass between them. Soft grey daylight. The important part is in the upper two thirds of the picture.

scenes.principle: They heard Yahweh God walking in the garden and hid from him, and he called: where are you?
scenes.shows: A small boy hides behind a long curtain beside a broken vase, as his father's shadow falls across the floor from the doorway.
scenes.prompt: In a sunny living room a small boy hides behind a long pale curtain, only his socks and the outline of his small body showing, his eyes peeking out anxiously. On the floor nearby lies a broken flower vase. Through the open doorway the long shadow of his father falls across the floorboards as he walks in looking for him. The important part is in the upper two thirds of the picture.

scenes.principle: The man blames the woman, and the woman blames the snake.
scenes.shows: Beside a broken plate a husband points at his wife, and she points at the cat on the counter.
scenes.prompt: In a bright kitchen beside a smashed plate on the floor, a husband points accusingly at his wife, and the wife points at the cat sitting on the counter, who stares back calmly. Each of their faces says 'it wasn't me'. The important part is in the upper two thirds of the picture.

scenes.principle: The snake is cursed: on your belly you will go, and dust you will eat all your life.
scenes.shows: A snake slides on its belly across dry, dusty, cracked ground, its head low in the dirt.
scenes.prompt: Close to the ground, a long snake slides on its belly across dry, dusty, cracked earth, a faint cloud of dust rising around it, its head pressed low in the dirt. Flat bright hazy light over a barren dry plain. The important part is in the upper two thirds of the picture.

scenes.principle: Hostility between the snake and the woman's offspring: he will strike your head, and you will strike his heel.
scenes.shows: Close-up: a snake's open mouth just short of a boot heel as the boot's sole comes down over its head.
scenes.prompt: Close-up at ground level on a dry dirt path: a snake with its mouth open lunges at the heel of a work boot, while the boot's heavy sole is coming down over the snake's head. Only the boot is seen. Sharp clear daylight. The important part is in the upper two thirds of the picture.

scenes.principle: To the woman: in pain you will bear children.
scenes.shows: In a hospital room a woman in labour grips her husband's hand with all her strength, her face strained with pain.
scenes.prompt: In a hospital delivery room a woman in labour, in a plain hospital gown and covered by a blanket, lies propped up in bed gripping her husband's hand with all her strength, her face strained with pain and her brow damp. Her husband leans close beside the bed, holding on. Soft daylight from a window. The important part is in the upper two thirds of the picture.

scenes.principle: The ground is cursed because of the man: painful toil, thorns and thistles, all the days of his life.
scenes.shows: Under a hot white sky a farmer in a sweat-soaked shirt hacks at thorns and thistles in a dry stony field.
scenes.prompt: Under a hot hazy white sky, a farmer in a sweat-soaked work shirt bends over a dry stony field overgrown with thorny thistles, hacking at them with a hoe. Sweat runs down his face, and the thistles stand thick all round him. The important part is in the upper two thirds of the picture.

scenes.principle: By the sweat of your face you will eat bread until you return to the ground: you are dust, and to dust you will return.
scenes.shows: An old man's weathered open hand lets dry earth run out between his fingers back to the ground.
scenes.prompt: Close-up of an old man's weathered, wrinkled open hand held out over dry ground, letting dry dust and earth run out between his fingers and fall back to the earth below. Soft side light catches the falling dust. The important part is in the upper two thirds of the picture.

scenes.principle: Eve, mother of all the living; and Yahweh God made tunics of skin and clothed them.
scenes.shows: At the door of a warm house on a cold windy evening, an older man seen from behind wraps a sheepskin coat round a shivering young couple.
scenes.prompt: At the open door of a warm, lamplit house on a cold windy evening, an older man, seen from behind, wraps a thick warm sheepskin coat round the shoulders of a shivering young man and woman who stand close together with their heads bowed. Warm light from the house falls on them. The important part is in the upper two thirds of the picture.

scenes.principle: Yahweh God sent the human out of the garden of Eden to work the ground from which he was taken.
scenes.shows: Seen from behind, a young couple with small bundles walk away along a dusty road from the open gate of a lush walled garden.
scenes.prompt: Seen from behind, a young man and woman of today carrying small bundles walk away along a dusty road from the open gate of a lush green walled garden, out toward a dry bare plain under a grey sky. The green garden behind them, the dry land ahead. The important part is in the upper two thirds of the picture.

scenes.principle: East of the garden he stationed the cherubim and the flame of the whirling sword to guard the way to the tree of life.
scenes.shows: A tall closed iron gate in a high garden wall with a wall of flame across the path before it, a single great tree shining inside.
scenes.prompt: A tall closed wrought-iron gate set in a high old stone garden wall. Across the path right in front of the gate a wall of bright flame burns. Through the bars, deep inside the lush garden, a single great tree stands bathed in shining light. The important part is in the upper two thirds of the picture.
